label: 四足前俯 / 臀部高抬
pose_lead: Grounded pose, quadruped forward lean with the hips high:
lower_limbs: Both knees rest on the ground with the lower legs folded back and some distance between the knees.
upper_limbs: Both hands press the ground, arms essentially straight.
torso_head: The upper body slopes clearly forward and down, the hips rising high, the head also lowering.
weight_silhouette: Weight rests on both knees and palms; the back runs in a visible descending line from hips to shoulders.
